BEFORE ANY REAL PAYMENT

Controls that must be satisfied

  1. Partner agreement and product eligibility verified
  2. Buyer explicitly accepts pre-purchase attribution
  3. Payment signature, capture, settlement and delivery verified independently
  4. Refund/chargeback adjustment and minimum 45-day hold
  5. Accurate annual tier calculation and negative reconciliation
  6. Independent KYC, verified bank owner, tax/GST/TDS sign-off and invoice
  7. Separate preparer and two distinct finance approvers
  8. Manual bank reconciliation and immutable payout reference

The sandbox intentionally checks logic and staff separation. It does not satisfy KYC, tax, bank or gateway verification in the live business.

Read the published commercial and payout terms

AUDITABLE SEPARATION OF DUTIES

Test finance review drafts

Drafts contain the scenario ID and authenticated operator IDs only. A preparer cannot sign either approval; the second reviewer must be different from both the preparer and first reviewer. Completed approval remains a simulation and never permits payout.
